🐾 Pet Care Unleashed

Welcome to Dr.JayPetTalks — where better pet parenting begins! 🐾

I’m a veterinarian, pet parent to my beloved Mango, and a veterinary surgeon with experience caring for and performing operations on exotic animals. 🐶🐱🦜🐢

Here, I’ll share practical vet tips, pet-care advice, preventive health guidance, nutrition, common problems, and better ways to understand and care for your pets — from everyday companions to fascinating exotic animals.

Whether you’re a first-time pet parent or a lifelong animal lover, Mango and I are here to help you give your pets a healthier, happier life. ❤️
